title: Context-switch review journal and microtask checklist
content:
Context-switch review journal (notes to self)

Purpose: capture quick heuristics and a tiny checklist that I can paste into PR comments so I don’t lose momentum when I get interrupted. Also logging short-lived thoughts about refactor ideas and potential followups. This is intentionally terse — copy/paste friendly.

Why this exists
- Reviews are frequently interrupted; when I come back I spend ~5–12 minutes re-orienting.
- Small notes that encode where I left off reduce that overhead and make reviews more continuous.
- Want a single place with microtask templates and opinionated gating rules (fast to use during a 20–30m review slot).

Quick heuristics (one-liners to paste into PRs)
- If you need to change >3 files in separate subsystems, split into an RFC + dep PR.
- Prefer small behavioral changes over large API surface changes in the same PR. If both are necessary, isolate the behavior change behind a flag.
- If test coverage is unclear: leave a failing test that reproduces the bug and mark WIP; easier to iterate than to guess.

Timebox templates
- Fast pass (10–20m): read description, run tests, skim diff for obvious opt-outs (security, perf, threading). Leave 3 small TODOs max.
- Deep pass (40–90m): check correctness of edge cases, run local benchmark where relevant, validate migration scripts, review e2e path.
- Microtask window (15m): pick one actionable item only — e.g., 'rename variable X for clarity' or 'extract helper for repeated parsing'.

Microtask checklist (copyable)
- [ ] Does the PR description state the user-visible change? (Yes / No)
- [ ] Are the new public APIs documented or marked for follow-up? (Doc link or TODO)
- [ ] Are there obvious invariants/assertions for complicated code paths? (Add asserts if missing)
- [ ] Tests: Unit tests for logic, integration for happy path, and a short negative case? (Y/N)
- [ ] Performance: any added allocations or hot loops? Quick note if unknown.
- [ ] Security: new input-parsing? Validate/escape or list as follow-up.
- [ ] Rollout plan: feature-flag, canary, or immediate? Short note.

Refactor idea capture (quick, bullet style)
- Problem observed: "diff contains repeated header parsing in 3 places (serving, CLI, load tests)"
- Small refactor: extract header.parseToMap(util) + add comment about expected header normalization.
- Migration cost: low — 1 internal helper + update callers (approx 45m).
- Risk: medium if callers rely on previous-case-sensitivity (add unit tests).

Rollforward vs rollback quick guide
- If a bug is limited (single endpoint, short rollback path) prefer rollback. If the change is entangled (schema change, DB migration) prefer rollforward with mitigation + canary.
- If reverting would cause data loss, do not revert blindly; instead deploy a safety patch that rejects new input and migrate data.

Common antipatterns I keep seeing in PRs
- Blob PRs: mixing refactor + new feature + perf. If I see this, I mark for split.
- No sentinel tests: PRs that change parsing/validation without a small test that asserts the broken input causes desired error.
- Hidden config: magic constants sprinkled in code instead of a named const + comment.

How I leave comments when interrupted
- Use a short header like: "REVIEW PAUSE — left at file: pkg/kv/cache.go, line ~132" when I need to stop.
- Add an anchor note: "TODO: verify eviction logic when seq wraps (I couldn't repro quickly)". That gets auto-inserted as a task in my head and the PR thread.

Example paste-ready reviewer comment (short):
---
Quick pass: ran unit tests and smoke. Left notes inline for two guarded cases.
Microtasks I'd prioritize if you want a quick merge:
1) Add a unit test that asserts header parsing normalizes duplicates.
2) Split the helper into pkg/http/header_util.go (1 file).
3) Add a short comment about case sensitivity and a TODO to add a regression test.
If you want me to re-review after those, ping me and I’ll do a 20m deep pass.
---

Followup log (place to quickly jot followups for a follow-up PR)
- INF-2987: add regression test for header case normalization (blocked on infra flaky harness)
- Perf micro: measure allocation cost in ServeBatch — seems ~8 allocs/op extra when batch size 1. If >5 allocs it's worth a micro-optim.

Quick priority tags (my shorthand)
- P0: break/incorrect behavior or security
- P1: correctness but non-blocking
- P2: readability, micro-optim, comments

Notes-to-self about context switching
- If interrupted mid-file, leave a one-line "anchor" comment in the PR so when I come back I don't need to re-open the file to find where I was.
- Use the microtask checklist when I'm in the 15m slot. It helps me leave only a single next-action.
- Periodically prune this doc: if a heuristic becomes stale move it to team playbook.

Questions / open items
- Is there appetite in the team for a one-button 'create followup PR' template in the web UI that auto-populates TODOs? (ask in #eng-reviews)
- Can we get a small GH action to block merges if the PR title contains WIP + merges? (ticket: INF-3052?)

End of notes.

Recent anchors (for quick orientation when returning)
- 2024-11-14: left at pkg/serve/batcher.go when verifying KV cache eviction path.
- 2024-12-02: paused during perf run, noted potential extra allocs in protobuf unmarshalling (benchmark id: bench/serve/unmarshal/dec-2024).

Short-term TODO (for me)
- [ ] Convert this into a tiny GH comment template and add to my snippets.
- [ ] Share with team in next async review sync.
- [ ] Create INF ticket for 'followup PR template' if others like it.
